{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) and the Foreign Bank and Asset Reporting Requirements result in the government's warrantless seizure of personal financial information without reasonable suspicion or probable cause.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Americans overseas should enjoy the same rights as Americans residing in the United States, whose private financial information is not subject to disclosure to the government except as to interest earned.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The requirement for all banks around the world to provide detailed information to the IRS about American account holders outside the United States has resulted in banks refusing service to them.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"FATCA not only allows \"unreasonable search and seizures\" but also threatens the ability of overseas Americans to lead normal lives.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the repeal of FATCA.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for a change to residency-based taxation for U.S. citizens overseas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Constitution's guarantee that no one can \"be deprived of life, liberty or property\" deliberately echoes the Declaration of Independence's proclamation that \"all\" are \"endowed by their Creator\" with the inalienable right to life.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The unborn child has a fundamental right to life which cannot be infringed.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for a human life amendment to the Constitution.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for legislation to make clear that the Fourteenth Amendment's protections apply to children before birth.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
